title: Navier Partner Proposal
description: Partner-facing pitch document. WEB FOCUS: showcase the NEED for marine mobility, the JOURNEYS unlocked, the MULTIMODAL fit, and that we know their LOCAL use cases. Commercial model / unit economics live in the deck, NOT here. All v2 fields are optional and backward-compatible.

layout.description: RENDER MODE. 'single' = flat one-page proposal (default; single-territory partners). 'hub' = index landing page (global thesis + map + market grid) with per-market deep-dives at /{partner_id}/{market.slug}. Bare /{partner_id} renders the index. Use 'hub' for multi-market platforms (Uber, Bolt, Grab).

network_thesis.description: INDEX-ONLY (layout=hub). The global network argument shown on the landing page above the market grid. Scale + optionality, partner-and-need framed.

how_to_read.description: One line telling the partner they can pick one market or the whole network.

partner_context.description: OPEN WITH THEIR WORLD, not our product. Their ambition + the pressure they're under + where Navier slots in.

title.description: e.g. Grab x Navier - the black-car network, on the water

why_now.description: WHY MARINE MOBILITY WITH NAVIER, NOW. The step-change argument grounded in the KB (reference/why-now-why-navier-mobility-pitch.md): the water is the last unmodernized mobility surface; hydrofoiling = ~10x more efficient + faster + smoother + quieter, with autonomy on the way; NO NEW INFRASTRUCTURE - it uses the oceans and berths that already exist (fundamentally unlike flying taxis, which need vertiports, new certification, and community-noise fights); and the Maldives network proves the model is real and ramping today. Lean into the wow corridors we can unlock now. DO NOT frame Navier vs other hydrofoil makers - this is partner-and-need focused, not competitive.

why_navier_now.description: OPTIONAL structured version of the why-now argument for richer rendering. Positive, partner-and-need focused. NEVER competitor-vs framing.

step_change.description: Why this is a leap, not an increment: flies above the water, ~10x efficiency, faster/smoother/quieter, autonomy-capable.

no_new_infrastructure.description: Uses existing oceans + berths; no vertiports, no new right-of-way, no charging dependency on the hybrid. Contrast with flying taxis / new-infrastructure modes.

the_moment.description: Why now: decarbonization mandates, tech crossed prototype->platform, hybrid removes the charging excuse, autonomy arrives on water first.

wow_corridors.description: The marquee corridors we can light up today that make people lean in.

precedents.description: OPTIONAL. Regional/other-market precedents that ADD CONFIDENCE to what we're doing (e.g. the Maldives network at scale; electric-hydrofoil commuter services already operating; ferry-electrification mandates). Use only where it strengthens the case - do NOT force-fit, and do NOT frame as Navier-vs-competitor.

multimodal_fit.description: How Navier slots into the partner's EXISTING multimodal footprint (app/booking, last-mile, intermodal hubs). The water layer of a stack they already run.

journeys_unlocked.description: THE hero feature. Concrete local A->B journeys that prove we know their use cases: today's pain vs the Navier trip. Keep these vivid and specific.

today.description: how the journey is made today + the pain

differentiation.description: Light, web-appropriate, POSITIVE. No economics. NO competitor-vs-competitor framing (no Candela/hydrofoil-rival comparisons - those live in the deck, not the website). Answers 'why this instead of the status quo (conventional/diesel boats and fast ferries)' and 'what makes Navier the platform to build the marine layer on'.

vs_status_quo.description: Why Navier beats today's conventional/diesel transfer boats and fast ferries: ~10x efficiency, no pounding/seasickness, quiet, lower cost per passenger-mile.

why_navier.description: What makes Navier the platform: software-defined + standardized, autonomy-ready, hybrid removes charging dependency, Maldives network at scale as live proof.

proof_points.description: Sourced credibility. Every external number should carry evidence.

objections.description: FAQ: range, sea-state/weather, safety & first-of-class certification, charging infra, seasonality.

phases.description: An operating sequence, not a brochure. Each phase explains WHY this, WHY now, WHY this order.

cities.description: city_ids lit in this phase (MUST match map node feature IDs)

routes.description: route ids lit in this phase

route_scope.description: which routes to highlight for the phase cities

featured_routes.description: human-readable marquee routes for the side panel

timeline.description: e.g. 2026 H2 - the momentum cue (NOT financials)

rationale.description: why this phase sits here in the sequence

use_cases.description: local journey/use-case types proven in this phase; strings and {label, summary}/{title, body} objects are renderer-supported

markets.description: Multi-market deep-dives (layout=hub). Each market is a full mini-proposal reachable at /{partner_id}/{slug}. The index renders one card per market from {label, summary, anchor_cities}; clicking opens the deep-dive. ALL markets are presented as equal, real opportunities — do NOT tier or hedge them as 'optionality only'. Content depth may vary, but framing is uniform. Each market should aim for the gold-standard bar (6 journeys / 4 proof / 4 objections / 4 phases) where research supports it.

slug.description: URL segment for /{partner_id}/{slug}; defaults to id.

summary.description: one-to-two sentence card blurb for the index grid

recommended_entry.description: marks the suggested starting market on the index (avoids choice paralysis); does NOT diminish the others

status.description: freeform momentum cue, e.g. 'live network adjacency', 'ready now' — NOT exclusivity or commitment language

anchor_cities.description: city_ids used for the card thumbnail + market map focus (MUST match map node feature IDs)

use_cases.description: market-summary-level use-case chips/cards; at least two are required for newly promoted Phase 3 binds to be proposal-ready

the_ask.description: Division of labour + the concrete next step. Web-safe (no economics).
